name: Receding-Horizon Native-NCE Consensus for HJ
observed_failure: HJ's own gate/risk cannot distinguish beneficial and harmful states
unsb_object: full optimizer-state transition under the native PatchNCE component
derivation: From the same immutable full state S_k, compute B0=Phi_0^32(S_k) and Bi=Phi_hj^32(S_k). Let Delta=NCE(Bi)-NCE(B0). Commit Bi iff Delta<0; otherwise commit B0.
identity_condition: Delta_NCE >= 0 commits the exact plain branch
self_null_condition: a rejected proposal contributes zero parameters, moments, schedulers, streams or RNG state
paired_target_proof: the decision reads only branch-averaged unpaired NCE; PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS and confirmation identities are absent from the controller interface
expected_valid_states: states whose 32-step observable retains its audited lead relationship
falsification_test: proposal-only, observable-only/plain, and full selector from the same e0; kill if the selector chooses harmful H200 branches or fails the 2400-step late gate
compute_cost: two 32-update branches per committed 32 updates; proposal branch inherits parent-probe cost
memory_cost: one live branch at a time plus one CPU full-state snapshot
pseudocode: commit proposal if mean(NCE)_proposal < mean(NCE)_plain else plain
